props.subhead: Maintenance, diagnostics and fleet advice from the people who work on these trucks and trailers every day.

image.alt: A technician on a creeper under a white International truck with its hood raised in the Sun State service bay

props.text: What we write about is what comes through the bays: alignment and tire wear, air brake and suspension parts, electrical faults, fuel system care, oil change intervals, and how fleets keep unplanned downtime off the schedule.

Truck posts come from our International service and parts teams; trailer posts come from Sun State Trailers. If something here applies to a unit you run, call 800.741.7566 and we'll look at the specific truck instead of the general case.

items.q: Who writes the Sun State blog?
items.a: Posts come from our service, parts and aftermarket teams — the technicians and specialists who work on International trucks and Hyundai Translead and Globe trailers every day across Tampa, Sarasota, Davenport and Brooksville.

items.q: What topics does the blog cover?
items.a: Preventative maintenance and oil change intervals, alignment, air brake and suspension parts, electrical diagnostics, fuel system care, fleet service programs, trailer repair, and what to expect from an International truck service center.

items.q: Does the blog cover trailers as well as trucks?
items.a: Yes. Sun State Trailers covers trailer repair topics including finding parts, getting a trailer repaired quickly after a breakdown, and mobile trailer service, alongside the truck maintenance posts.

items.q: Can I get help with something I read here?
items.a: Yes. Call 800.741.7566 or submit a service appointment request, and a service advisor will look at the specific unit rather than the general case.
